spanish: y vendrá el sacerdote y verá, y he aquí se extendió la plaga en la casa: tsaráat maligna ella en la casa; impura ella.

findings.issue: Common noun צָרַעַת (H6883, feminine singular absolute) is left as the untranslated form tsaráat; common nouns stay Spanish.
Masculine singular adjective טָמֵא and 3ms pronoun הוּא are rendered feminine, so this clause no longer matches the masculine referent distinguished from the preceding 3fs הִוא.
Hiphil active feminine participle is smoothed to the bare adjective maligna; causative verbal force is not visible.
Qal perfect 3ms (not reflexive) is smoothed with Spanish se.

notes: 3fs הִוא is correctly ella; the following 3ms הוּא is not.
